title: A problem with my order
instructions: Kerem online sipariş ettiği ürünle ilgili müşteri hizmetlerini arıyor. Sorunu ve çözümü takip et.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Good morning, Home Style customer service.

script.speaker: kerem
script.text: Hi. I ordered a lamp from your website last week, but there's a problem.

script.speaker: kerem
script.text: I ordered a white one, but you sent a black one.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: I'm very sorry about that. Can I have your order number?

script.speaker: kerem
script.text: It's four five seven two nine.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Thank you. We'll send you a white lamp tomorrow, and a driver will collect the black one at the same time.

script.speaker: kerem
script.text: Do I need to pay for that?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: No, it's free. And we'll give you a ten percent discount on your next order.
